summary: Security review found no new evidenced authentication or authorization flaw; JWT validation and protected task isolation tests pass.
decisions: JWTs require HS256 signatures with a configured 32-byte minimum secret and enforce expiration; invalid and expired tokens are rejected.
Passwords use per-user random salts, PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256, and constant-time hash comparisons.
Task SQL is parameterized and every task read, update, and delete is scoped to the authenticated user ID.
Validated syntax and ran `python3 -m unittest -v test_api.py` successfully (5 passing).
